reference_opening.argument: This video is non-scam content because it is a Star Wars-themed song about a fictional legion and its battles, with references to droids, Jedi, clones, burning planets, and returning to battle. The channel is described as focusing on science fiction, fantasy, films, games, books, series, and comics, while its support and social links are not connected to a deceptive solicitation.

citations.quote: Legion goes into battle: a song about star wars
the clones are killing us, the Jedi are fighting, the villages are burning, the cities are burning, the planets are burning
Subscribe and click the bell so as not to miss new videos!

opening.argument: The video is presented as entertainment, but its surrounding call to action creates a concrete participation pathway: viewers are told to subscribe and are given separate links for monthly and single support. That pairing matters because the audience is directed from attention to an external action and potential transfer, while the material does not explain what a supporter receives in return. The entertainment framing can therefore obscure the commercial solicitation that accompanies it.

citations.quote: Subscribe and click the bell so as not to miss new videos!
Monthly support of the channel: https://you.support/valybalalay
Single support of the channel: http://www.donationalrts.ru/r/chepacheps

rebuttal.rebuttal: Calling the subject a Star Wars song does not answer the separate issue of the external action pathway. The defense identifies fictional lyrics and film-oriented branding, but those points do not explain why viewers are directed to monthly and single support links. Nor does a generic subscription request establish that the linked solicitation is transparent or that supporters receive no promised benefit.

citations.quote: Legion goes into battle: a song about star wars
The Geek channel Valaybalalay is dedicated to science fiction, fantasy and other genres of cinema, games, books, series and comics.

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The cited material shows ordinary channel support, not a reward, withdrawal promise, or asset-acquisition offer. “Monthly support” and “Single support” describe voluntary contributions; the evidence does not say contributors will receive money or another return. The fictional lyrics and entertainment description also make the content's primary purpose clear.

citations.quote: Monthly support of the channel: https://you.support/valybalalay
The Geek channel Valaybalalay is dedicated to science fiction, fantasy and other genres of cinema, games, books, series and comics.

opening.argument: Several risk signals appear together in the description: repeated external links, a direct subscription prompt, and separate monthly and single support destinations. The video itself supplies emotionally intense battle imagery and lyrics about burning cities and returning to battle, while the description surrounds that attention-grabbing material with payment-related links. A careful reviewer should treat that combination as a solicitation requiring scrutiny, especially because no terms, benefit, or verification context is supplied for the support flow.

citations.quote: Subscribe and click the bell so as not to miss new videos!
All the necessary links: Valiya in VK: https://vk.com/valybalalay
Monthly support of the channel: https://you.support/valybalalay
the villages are burning, the cities are burning, the planets are burning, the sectors are burning

rebuttal.rebuttal: The defense focuses on fictional subject matter, but that does not neutralize the unusual density of off-platform destinations and payment prompts. The absence of an explicit promise in the cited opening is precisely why the surrounding link structure deserves attention: viewers are encouraged to act externally without being shown clear conditions or a defined benefit.

citations.quote: All the necessary links:
Single support of the channel: http://www.donationalrts.ru/r/chepacheps

true_side_reply.rebuttal: External social and support links are not inherently scam indicators. Nothing in the supplied text mentions crypto, investment, guaranteed returns, prizes, withdrawals, or verification. The dramatic language is song content, not a financial claim, and the cited support links are plainly labeled rather than presented as an investment or reward opportunity.

citations.quote: The final (I hope) version of the song "Legion goes into battle" is dedicated to the clones of the Great Army of the Republic
the empire will be born again
Monthly support of the channel: https://you.support/valybalalay

opening.argument: Although the video presents itself as a song, the surrounding description functions as channel promotion and audience conversion. It advertises the channel's subject matter, asks viewers to subscribe, provides advertising and cooperation contact information, and lists multiple social and support destinations. The entertainment format therefore also serves to steer viewers toward ongoing engagement and external participation. The absence of a clearly stated benefit for those actions makes the promotional layer difficult to evaluate as a transparent offer.

citations.quote: On this channel you will learn the most interesting about other worlds: from horrors to science fiction, from fantasy to cyberpan!
Subscribe and click the bell so as not to miss new videos!
For advertising and cooperation, write in personal messages in VK: https://vk.com/natalia_adisom
Single support of the channel: http://www.donationalrts.ru/r/chepacheps

rebuttal.rebuttal: The defense treats the song format as dispositive, but the description explicitly expands beyond the song into audience growth, advertising, cooperation, and support. Those are promotional functions, not merely context for fictional lyrics. Calling the links “not connected to deceptive solicitation” assumes the conclusion; the supplied material does not establish what happens after viewers follow them or what they are promised.

citations.quote: For advertising and cooperation, write in personal messages in VK: https://vk.com/natalia_adisom
Subscribe and click the bell so as not to miss new videos!

true_side_reply.rebuttal: Promotion and monetization do not by themselves establish a scam category. The evidence shows a creator promoting a science-fiction channel and requesting support, but it does not show a false reward, deceptive return, or asset-acquisition promise tied to those actions. The song's fictional framing remains consistent with the stated channel purpose.
